footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to UL Solutions: after $20.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.4% to $3.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 49.5%, versus 48.5% a year earlier, and operating income rose 13.0% to $522M, a 17.1% margin.
Net income fell 0.3% to $325M, or $1.60 per share. Operating cash flow was $600M and free cash flow $403M, versus $287M; UL Solutions returned $104M through dividends.
sources: UL Solutions Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
